The climate in Barcelona

Barcelona is about 25 m above sea level. The warmest month is July, with an average high of 29°C; the coldest is January, when nights average 5°C. Around 640 mm of precipitation falls in a year on average, most of it in October (about 105 mm). The highest temperature in Barcelona in 2015–2024 was 37°C (30 July 2024) and the lowest −1°C (18 January 2017).

Best time to visit Barcelona

The most pleasant weather in Barcelona is usually in May, June, September and October: average highs are between 22°C and 26°C, with up to 12 days of rain a month.
